name: Marc Riedl
institution: UC San Diego — Division of Rheumatology, Allergy & Immunology
bio: One of the most prolific HAE researchers in the US, Dr. Riedl has led or co-authored landmark studies on prophylactic therapy and patient-reported outcomes in HAE. He is frequently cited in guideline development and is a sought-after speaker at international HAE congresses.

publicationHighlights.title: Long-term outcomes of subcutaneous lanadelumab in HAE type I and II: 5-year registry data
Patient preference for route of administration in HAE prophylaxis: a multinational survey
Comparative efficacy of approved HAE prophylactics: a systematic review and network meta-analysis

congressAppearances.topic: Long-term real-world data for subcutaneous prophylaxis
Guideline update: prophylaxis decision-making in HAE
Patient-centric endpoints in HAE clinical trials

disclosedRelationships: Advisory board: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals (disclosed in JACI 2024)
Speaker bureau: Takeda Pharmaceuticals (disclosed in Ann Allergy 2023)
Research grant: Pharma Inc (disclosed in Allergy 2022)
whatItMeansForPharmaInc: Riedl is one of the few KOLs with a disclosed relationship with Pharma Inc — this is a significant asset. His dual affiliation with Takeda and BioCryst means his public statements need careful monitoring for shifts in how he frames the oral vs. injectable debate.

name: Hilary Longhurst
bio: A leading European HAE specialist and former chair of the UK HAE Association medical advisory board, Dr. Longhurst is one of the most influential voices in European HAE guideline development. Her endorsement of emerging therapies carries significant weight with European payers and physicians.

publicationHighlights.title: Oral bradykinin receptor antagonism in HAE: mechanism, evidence and clinical implications
European HAE patient journey: barriers to optimal prophylaxis uptake
Positioning of new oral agents in the HAE treatment algorithm: a European perspective

congressAppearances.topic: Oral therapies for HAE: where do they fit in the treatment algorithm?
European guideline update — prophylaxis thresholds and shared decision-making
Emerging oral agents in HAE: clinical trial interpretation

disclosedRelationships: Advisory board: Pharvaris BV (disclosed in Clin Exp Allergy 2025)
Speaker honorarium: Takeda Pharmaceuticals (disclosed in Orphanet J 2024)
Advisory board: CSL Behring (disclosed in JACI Pract 2023)
whatItMeansForPharmaInc: Longhurst is a critical voice for European market access — her framing of 'where oral agents fit in the treatment algorithm' will influence UK NICE and EMA assessments. Her Pharvaris advisory board role means she may publicly frame deucrictibant favourably ahead of Pharma Inc's own European launch.

name: Timothy Craig
institution: Penn State University — Division of Pulmonary, Allergy & Critical Care Medicine
bio: A prolific contributor to HAE clinical research with a focus on berotralstat and oral on-demand therapies, Dr. Craig has been closely associated with BioCryst's clinical program. He is a frequent presenter at US-focused allergy congresses and contributes regularly to US HAE treatment guidelines.

publicationHighlights.title: 24-month outcomes with berotralstat in a real-world US HAE registry
Patient-reported convenience and adherence with once-daily oral prophylaxis for HAE
Optimising prophylaxis selection in HAE: a US physician survey

congressAppearances.topic: Real-world adherence and outcomes with oral HAE prophylaxis
Convenience metrics in HAE prophylaxis: what patients actually want
US perspective on prophylaxis access and reimbursement

disclosedRelationships: Advisory board: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals (disclosed in Ann Allergy 2024)
Research grant: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals (disclosed in JACI 2023)
whatItMeansForPharmaInc: Craig's deep ties to BioCryst and focus on convenience messaging make him a likely voice for oral prophylaxis as the default standard — a framing that may inadvertently benefit Sebetralstat's oral on-demand positioning if Pharma Inc can engage him early.

name: Anette Bygum
bio: A leading Scandinavian HAE specialist and principal investigator in multiple HAE trials across European sites, Dr. Bygum is considered an independent voice in the field with no current commercial advisory relationships. Her research focuses on epidemiology, genetics, and health-related quality of life in HAE.

publicationHighlights.title: Health-related quality of life in HAE: a Nordic registry study
Epidemiology of hereditary angioedema in Scandinavia: updated estimates
Unmet needs in HAE management: patient and physician perspectives across Europe

congressAppearances.topic: Nordic registry data: treatment patterns and outcomes in HAE
Unmet needs in HAE — what the data tell us

disclosedRelationships: No commercial relationships disclosed in recent publications
whatItMeansForPharmaInc: Bygum's independence makes her a credible third-party voice. Her quality-of-life and unmet needs research aligns well with Pharma Inc's positioning — she would be a high-value target for early engagement and investigator-initiated research collaboration.

name: Konrad Bork
bio: One of Europe's most experienced HAE clinicians with over three decades of clinical and research experience, Dr. Bork is a foundational figure in HAE natural history research. His work on attack triggers, laryngeal attacks, and long-term prognosis is widely cited in treatment guidelines across Europe.

publicationHighlights.title: Triggers of HAE attacks and implications for prophylaxis selection: 30-year follow-up
Laryngeal HAE attacks: frequency, risk factors and fatality — updated European data
Natural history of HAE with C1-INH deficiency: a longitudinal cohort study

congressAppearances.topic: 30 years of HAE natural history: what we have learned
Prophylaxis thresholds in severe HAE — German guideline perspective

disclosedRelationships: Speaker bureau: Takeda Pharmaceuticals (disclosed in Allergy 2024)
whatItMeansForPharmaInc: Bork's focus on attack severity and laryngeal risk is relevant to Pharma Inc's on-demand indication — severe attack patients are a core target segment. His Takeda relationship is limited to speaker bureau, making him more approachable than advisory board-level affiliations.
